item.title: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei Clash Over Ads and the Future of A.I.
item.description: What started as a technical arms race between Sam Altman and Dario Amodei has evolved into a public feud over narrative control.

item.title: With “Happy Zoo,” Anita Lam Makes a Case for Artistic Environmentalism
item.description: Lam’s curatorial work sits at the intersection of art, ecology, technology and philosophy, but far from being preachy or pessimistic, her approach is playful and, at times, mischievous.

item.title: I Went to a Costa Rican Blue Zone to Reverse Time. My Face—and the Stars—Had Other Ideas
item.description: At Hacienda AltaGracia, a Blue Zone-adjacent retreat argues that living longer has less to do with optimization and more to do with tables, air and time.

item.title: At Christie’s, Irene Roosevelt Aitken’s Collection Tests the Market for Old-World Opulence
item.description: The dissolution of the prominent philanthropist's collection will reveal whether the haute billionaire appetite for such ornate fare still holds sway in the era of Mahdavi minimalism.

item.title: As Disney’s First Creative Chief, Dana Walden Set to Reshape Power After Bob Iger
item.description: As Disney pivots beyond Bob Iger, Dana Walden’s new role puts streaming growth and creative cohesion at the center of its future.

item.title: Rotterdam’s Reopened Photography Museum Celebrates the Medium’s Material Nature
item.description: The repurposed six-story cast-iron column structure houses one of the largest museum collections of photography in the world, as well as accoutrements such as vintage cameras, guidebooks, negatives, slides and prints.

item.title: Goldman Sachs’ Information Chief Marco Argenti Deepens A.I. Push with Anthropic
item.description: Goldman Sachs has been using Anthropic's A.I. tools internally for six months, Chief Information Officer Marco Argenti revealed. From coding to compliance, the bank is rolling out A.I. agents firmwide in one of Wall Street’s most ambitious automation efforts.

item.title: One Fine Show: “Nothing Still About Still Lifes” at the Deji Art Museum
item.description: The blockbusters on display are incredible and expensive—so much so that walking through the exhibition can feel like going to a really good preview at an auction house.

item.title: A Collector’s Guide to Non-Cash Museum Donations
item.description: Crypto philanthropy is emerging as a meaningful funding stream, particularly among younger and wealthier donor demographics.

item.title: How the Donum Estate Cultivated a World-Class Sculpture Garden
item.description: Art collectors Allan and Mei Warburg bought the land "without any concrete plan to build what would eventually become one of the world’s most significant contemporary sculpture collections. Everything else unfolded organically from there."
